jobs.job_title: Oracle Fusion Contracts Management Functional Consultant
jobs.job_description:
Scidecs is hiring a Senior Oracle Fusion Contracts Management (Enterprise Contracts) Functional Consultant for a 12-month contract with a large enterprise client in Saudi Arabia. Engagement: 12-month contract, immediate start. Work mode: Remote, aligned to KSA working hours (Sunday to Thursday). Onsite Riyadh option may be considered for the right profile.
About the Role
You will lead the design, implementation and optimisation of Oracle Fusion Enterprise Contracts within an Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP landscape, working directly with business stakeholders across Contract Management, Procurement and Supply Chain.
Key Responsibilities
Lead requirement-gathering workshops with business stakeholders.
Design Oracle Fusion Enterprise Contracts solutions aligned with Oracle best practices.
Configure Contracts Management, contract integrations, BPM approval workflows, contract security and user roles.
Run CRPs, SIT and UAT, and support production deployment and cutover.
Work with technical teams on integrations, reports, conversions and extensions.
Assess the impact of quarterly Oracle Cloud updates.
Prepare functional specs, configuration documents, test scripts and user guides.
Deliver end-user and super-user training and provide post-go-live support.
Mandatory Expertise
Oracle Fusion Enterprise Contracts: Contract Authoring, Terms Library, Clause Management, Templates, Approval Workflows, Deliverables, Compliance, Amendments, Contract Lifecycle Management.
Oracle Fusion Procurement: Purchasing, Self-Service Procurement, Procurement Contracts, Requisitions, Supplier Management.
Oracle Fusion Supply Chain: Sourcing, Supplier Collaboration, Inventory fundamentals, Order Management.
Integration of Contracts with AP, Supplier Management, Inventory, BPM Approvals and OTBI/BIP reporting.
Working knowledge of Fusion Security, OTBI, BI Publisher, OIC and FBDI/ADFDI.
Required Experience
10+ years of Oracle ERP consulting, including 5+ years on Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP. Minimum 3 full-cycle Oracle Fusion Enterprise Contracts implementations as Functional Lead. Multiple Oracle Fusion Supply Chain implementations. Experience with multinational organisations and leading executive-level workshops. Experience managing UAT and production cutover. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IS, Business, Supply Chain or related field. Oracle Fusion Cloud certifications highly preferred. Excellent English communication and stakeholder management skills.
Nice to Have:
Oracle Supplier Qualification, Supplier Portal, Sourcing, Risk Management Cloud.
AI capabilities within Oracle Fusion Applications.
Agile delivery experience.
Arabic language skills.
